answer: Each epoch the protocol posts A, this close's admission budget, and U, unestablished keys already accepted this epoch. An unestablished submit burns P=ceil(U/A) units of this epoch's per-head payout, struck at close. Seven slots and one waiting key cost 1. Each extra identity raises U, so the eighth pays 2 and a farm of n pays about n(n+1)/(2A). P cannot be reset, split, or pre-aged: A is posted at open and a new key cannot mint a slot. Refuse the burn and the submit is dropped. The timber of A caps slots; a terrace of keys lifts U; one honest submit still pays posted P on that ridge.
